details: For every finite binary class, the maximum 1-inclusion degree over all coordinate projections is at most its effective range.
proof: Every projection has no more effective coordinates than the original class. In each projected 1-inclusion graph, a vertex has at most one neighbor per effective coordinate. Taking the maximum over projections gives \mathrm d^p_{\max}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H).
name: Effective Range / Projected Maximal Degree
